summary: Verified the freshly rebuilt PRODUCTION frontend/dist served at the preview URL. Rebrand to 'AI Delphi Council', new product logo image, EN/FR language switcher, French localization (login + dashboard), persistence via localStorage, dev-login flow, terms modal, welcome screen, How-it-works 4 cards, and footer AfricAIsoft lockup all render correctly. No 'LLM Council' text and no scale/balance emoji anywhere. Only console errors are expected 401s on unauthenticated /api/auth/me calls.
verified_features: Login page shows brand text 'AI Delphi Council' and product logo (no scale emoji, no 'LLM Council').
Language switcher visible on /login with data-testid=language-switcher, lang-en, lang-fr.
FR click switches login card to 'Se connecter avec Google' and 'Accès développeur (aperçu)' live; EN click reverts to 'Sign in with Google' / 'Developer access (preview)'.
Preference persists across reload (localStorage app_lang=fr; body still French after reload).
Dev-login flow works: dev-toggle -> dev-email-input (bob@example.com) -> dev-login-button; terms-modal accepted via checkbox + accept button.

Post-login header shows product logo + 'AI Delphi Council' + EN/FR switcher; welcome screen shows 'Welcome to AI Delphi Council'; how-it-works section (data-testid=how-it-works) with 4 cards (Input/Enrich/Process/Output).
Footer shows '© 2026 AI Delphi Council' and 'by AfricAIsoft' lockup with logo image.
Toggling FR post-login translates whole UI live: 'Bienvenue sur AI Delphi Council', 'Comment ça marche', 'Nouvelle conversation', 'Discussion', 'Paramètres', 'crédits', 'Acheter des crédits'.
No blank screen; only expected 401 (pre-auth /api/auth/me) console errors; SPA loads and navigates on the production build.
test_credentials: Dev login: bob@example.com via dev-toggle UI
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL is currently serving the static production build (frontend/dist via serve -s), same-origin /api. i18n rebrand verified end-to-end on the deployed artifact.
rca of the issue: Original bug ('no localization / logo unchanged') was due to a stale committed frontend/dist that the production server was serving. Main agent rebuilt frontend/dist from current source; this run confirms the fresh build resolves the issue on the exact deployed artifact.
